detail.longDescription: Put a small thing on GitHub: gpu-router, a GPU inference control plane for a homelab. One router in front of per-machine rig managers, so mismatched GPUs answer on one OpenAI/Ollama-compatible endpoint. It schedules which models hold VRAM (pins, eviction, priority) and drives a real llama-swap backend. Honest v1 slice: single rig for now, no backpressure yet. The contract and known gaps are written down. AGPL-3.0. https:// github.com/StinkySunflower/gpu -router-oss # homelab # selfhosted # LocalLLM
